description: List the words of one Memrise lesson (scenario) with the learner's state for each word. Fails if this lesson's details cannot be fetched. If some lesson details cannot be fetched, results are still returned without those lesson links and a `warnings` field names the failed lesson ids. Each word row has word (in the language being learned) and translation (its meaning in the learner's own language). next_review is null unless the word is learned (words never studied, or already known, have none). The first call in a fresh process with a cold cache is noticeably slower because every completed lesson is fetched once; later calls are fast.
name: scenario_learnables
title: List the words of one lesson
